articles.headline: Wagner, Magic use big fourth quarter to drop Knicks to 0-3 with 111-102 victory
articles.description: — Franz Wagner scored 21 of his 23 points in the fourth quarter, and the Orlando Magic dropped the reigning champion New York Knicks to 0-3 with a 111-102 win Sunday night.
